messages.subject: Project Willow - SPA mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Attached is our mark-up of the SPA. The headline points: the general warranty cap is plainly too high - our clients can go no further than 15%; we've increased the de minimis to £50,000 and the basket to £500,000; and we've reduced the general warranty time limit to 18 months. The tax positions are broadly acceptable. Happy to discuss.

Regards,
Jonathan Vane
Castle & Vane LLP
